correctness.rationale: Proposition 2.9 supplies an if-and-only-if criterion. The verifier exhausts all 385032 exponents for every odd prime \(p<50\), uses partial unit tests only as a logically safe separating filter, and then evaluates every unit on all unresolved multi-orbit cells. Character orders, Frobenius orbits, and the non-midpoint \(p=37\) digit sums are checked by exact integer arithmetic.

value.rationale: The source paper itself uses small-field censuses to map when its converse problem fails. Completing the natural odd-prime cutoff \(p<50\) identifies the first degree-three characteristic in that range with additional equality types beyond the Evans order-14 family, and the two order-28 pairs lie outside the midpoint pure-sum regime. This supplies a concrete benchmark and boundary case for the new criterion rather than an arbitrary isolated computation.
